how: Scenario 3, point 3. SIM::DMM0 never answers `MEAS:VOLT:DC?` (faults.timeout, simulation.md 4 and 5): the query sent at 0 ms gets no answer, so the read waits the timeout of the session, 500 ms, and fails with `io.timeout`, code -1073807339 (simulation.md 6). `string.to_f64` and `time.wait` skip on it (spec 7.2): `x` is 0.0 and the wait takes no time; the loop stops on the error carry after that iteration (spec 6.3), at 500 ms, with n = 1.0 and s = 0.0 + 0.0, so `mean_a` = 0.0 / 1.0 = 0.0. `visa.close`, `always`, closes the session and passes the error on; `errors.merge(ca, cb)` makes it the main error (spec 7.4), so the status is `error` (spec 8.2). Branch B is not held by A (each instrument is its own, simulation.md 4): its ten readings and its mean are those of `noise.py 2 12 0.01 10`, the sum in the order of the readings then divided by n = 10.0, and it ends at 1000 ms. The command that got no answer has the answer `null`: kept from the previous file, as the documents do not say how the report writes it. Both sessions are closed.
